MT-Bench creator documentation at 587d5cf

benchmark-version.mtbench.587d5cf

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained MT-Bench documentation received separate AI source-content review. The source verifier also independently parsed the pinned 80-question JSONL artifact: unique IDs 81-160, eight categories of ten questions, and two turns per question. That check covers structure and counts; no semantic correctness, authorship, model answers, human judgments or model evaluation was audited. The pinned benchmark snapshot and parent family remain distinct; stated evaluator and rights limitations remain assertion-specific.
